Messages.Author: Bernard Gerald Donohue
Messages.Body:
When do you untap the vampire? After combat? Because a friend of mine
says that since it says Immediatly, then he untaps before combat occurs
but says my action is still blocked.

bg...@columbia.edu

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:



And he goes to combat untapped. This is the official answer from tom,
even though the ruling on superior Freak Drive (action modifier) is the
oppposite - you play it *after* the combat to untap the acting Vampire.

Sound a little schizoid to you too?
